notes.title: New Major Update: Kruger Update
notes.notes:
Kruger Update is here! 🦁


Hey Giants!  



The Kruger Update is now live with changes for the Savanna biome. You can read the full Patch Notes at the end of this Steam News.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/28d4d9df22cf271ba8474fe822fc82750dbccd21.gif"]



Check our Steam News highlighting two new biotica the Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon:

Reus 2 - Teaser Kruger Update: New residents! 🐒 - Steam News

Gamepad and Steamdeck Support feedback:


This update also comes with some new work on the Gamepad/Steamdeck version of the game. While we're working on the content roadmap, we're also experimenting with gamepad support. We hope to make Reus 2 a better experience using a controller or your Steam Deck.

Gamepad & Steam Deck support are a big step for us as they require quite some UI and Input rework. It's also relatively new to Abbey Games. So as always, we're aiming to develop this in further in tandem with the community. Will you help us test this gamepad adaptation?

How to access the experimental branch to test it?
To opt in to the playtest branch, use the Steam beta password: `CatAteTheMouse`

Please share your feedback on all things good and bad in a separate forum thread per issue or cluster of issues.

As always, thank you for any help, and we hope you enjoy!


What feedback are we looking for?
- All feedback on how your experience with the game is, specifically to the way it controls.

- This build also supports Mouse+Keyboard as before, so testing for regression issues with default PC controls is welcome too.

- Since we are not veteran Steam Deck users ourselves, we hope to learn how your experience beyond standard gamepad controls is.

Known issues:

- The controls layout UI always shows a generic gamepad, rather than specific Steam Deck visual.

- Navigation is quirky in some places.

- Some UIs still overlap.



We need all the feedback you can give to help us improve this version for its official release. You can share your feedback on Discord or in the Steam discussions in the dedicated channel and (newly created) sub-forum! Thank you all for helping us shaping Reus 2's future!


On a side note, we also have a Daily Deal on Steam with a 40% sale on the main game, 10% on the Supporter Pack and 20% on the DLCs starting today at 7PM CEST!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/c6acf4b3bb66ed0663f28b0441343e44610c4f81.png"]

Enjoy this new update and stay tuned for the next one! 



-Manuel and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Teaser Kruger Update: New residents! 🐒
notes.notes:
Hello, Jangwa movers! 🦁



This week, we’d love to showcase our two new Apex friends coming next week, the Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon. Let’s take a look!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/985890da614f404fdcff22a543b195a52657616c.png"]

The Hamadryas Baboon is designed to be a flexible Animal to add to your pack. It gives unorthodox gains for an animal, as long as you placed many  biotica. You’ll find yourself looking for good row synergies. But you also want to utilize its own Sunset ability with animals! Make sure to reserve a row to stack animals. It will work great with the herd animals, like the reworked Wildebeest, and collect many small bonuses from cohorts, like the reworked Egusi.  


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3f8b8b69f9422c2dcccd86a0b8bfa2152a614d1d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a402040f11add8f4db161a7ff06c8a73275d1259.png"][/carousel]


When looking for a matching Tier 3 Apex, look for those that also want animals - like the Elephant - or that bring a lot of Sunset abilities to the table - like the Sorghum! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/6decf9a85c55276ba52a212ffb15fd4e87eef270.png"]

The Meerkat can take up a scoring or a support role. Its Sunset ability scales well and is worth investing. However, Field Sentinel allows you to gain a multitude of Herbivores out of thin air. All for the cheap price of 5 Biodiversity. It is supported by an incredibly powerful Termite Hill that provides plenty of  tags. It’s almost like having 2 Apex for the price of 1!  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/d149b62ba8b9371cc97cf1cc0b3ad0dea103ec25.png"]

How will you use the Meerkat? Will they boost your animal kingdom, will they burrow their way to massive food gains? 

More Content: There are 3 other new cohorts we haven’t talked about: the Hoopoe, Pygmy Falcon, and Shepherd Tree. But we’ll let you figure those out yourself! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e902bfacf4c264081e34ac2006b894158d15dd37.gif"]



And a little bonus: the Bullfrog also has been changed! Now it provides a bioticum with all possible types! It might be a bit niche, but there are plenty of useful ways to get a lot out of those extra micro charges! 

We hope to see your new worlds next week on September the 12th! 



- Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Our fifth Roadmap & Coming soon: The Kruger Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, titanic friends!   



We have a lot of exciting news to share with you on Reus 2! Let’s cut to the chase, and highlight the new roadmap! 🗺️   



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/b6d191fdc4a165881da9fe0ba86171890a31a1b4.jpg"]

 Kruger Update - September 12th: an exciting update that not only adds 2 brand new apexes and 4 new cohorts, but hosts a complete overhaul of the Savanna! Scroll down to read more! ⬇️


 Nikko Update - November 2025:  A smaller update with focus on new features. One of them will allow you to randomize secondary biomes too, for brand new Horizon options! 



 Manchuria Update + DLC - 2026: I don’t want to spoil much about this update yet, but let’s just say it will add a lot of new biotica…  
Kruger Update: Savanna Rework


Players have pointed out that the Savanna was the only biome to not have received an upgrade since launch. Well, say no more! Our goals with the Kruger Update are: 

 Animals: Add more Animals to the Savanna to give that Safari vibe.


 Rows: Make row gameplay much more viable and synergetic


 Quality: Improve the general quality of the content so all paths have something special.


To do that, we touched almost every bioticum in the Savanna, and added a few to boot!
One thing you’ll notice immediately is that  and  are gone. They were hardly used. The  is replaced with the more general , which allows more Biotica to participate. Take a look at the Red Oat, a Savanna staple:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/5dfa7324ee11fd578b5dbdd2381f7024a2eb5dfd.png"]

Notice not only the  tag, but also the  tag: a new tag that highlights Biotica which uses in-row symbioses. You will find many more of them. Take a look at some of these reworks! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/78eefd74a10c597048e54d6b8f94e6bd8f52df16.png"]

We’re also adding a new Third Era, the Safari Planet! It challenges you to create a planet with mostly animals and score big with a Herbivore and Predator.
We’re also adding some cool female/male skins for some animals! The Savanna deserves as much!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/b65607db824ed0bbeaaa6ee3ee7919c4d01caa90.png"] 

 🦁 Tune in next week to read more about the 2 new Apex: The Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon!


And talking about Savanna, check out the amazing Pikminenco's video on how to bring the Giant Jangwa to life![previewyoutube="A-O6oBE1t4w;full"][/previewyoutube]
 Greetings from the Abbey!

-Adriaan and the Monks from the Abbey

notes.title: 1 year anniversary release of Reus 2, how far we’ve come! 🎂
notes.notes:
Hey Giants!

It’s been a year since Reus 2 was released, and so many amazing things have happened, we had to celebrate this with you. Whether you’re here since Reus 1, or you’ve just discovered Reus 2 with the latest update, you’re part of our great community, and we would not be here without you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/86d4e530a2d3125bb7a483273a96c2beba1650ae.gif

Reus 2 continues to grow, with DLC and updates, and you’re still here with us so thank you, this celebration is also yours.

Not 1, not 2, but 3 winners for our giveaway

And to truly celebrate this anniversary, we wanted to do a special giveaway with 3 winners who can win the all-included edition of Reus 2, which contains the main game, the Ice Age DLC and the Supporter Pack! You can even gift your prize to a loved one so you can share your best symbiosis together!

🎁 Participate in the giveaway HERE! 🎁
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/43e4b4d154a39841dc2c64a0b914f0dacb9ca43c.png

A fantastic journey

The monks have been working hard on keeping Reus 2 fresh and fun! We’d like to highlight the updates released this year:

 Spirited World: the first update added the Botanist and Diplomat to the game.
 Zhangjiajie Milestone: Added Simplified Chinese and some China based content.
 Great Barrier Reef: A big update for the Ocean; The Dolphin, Reef Shark, Christmas Tree Coral and Shipwreck were added!
 Central Park Update: This is where you get your Kentucky coffee trees and doves. It was a small surprise!
 Atlantic Forest: A big one! New giant abilities like Anomaly, a package of rainforest biotica, and the tropical paradise era.
 Amur Update: The City of Dreams and Small World is added next to some new Taiga content. The last big free content update.
 Cataclysm & Ice Age: The return of wars and relationships! Many people were waiting for it, many people were unsure about it. In the end, we only had 1 complaint. And that person didn’t discover they could just turn off the conflicts. The DLC was super fun to make, and exceeded our expectations!
 Micro Kingdom: Not full of content, but a big shift in gameplay! Better modes, and a whole new micro and emblem system.
 Uluru Update: Bringing more life from the outback to the desert. We hope you’ll enjoy the new content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e7451bae6c5621b7fd5ae6044999ae699b592769.png
We’re very proud of all the quality and work we delivered, and the reviews seem to agree. We’re proud to be still rated overwhelmingly positive! Not only that: Reus 2 has now been played over a million hours! We sincerely hope those hours brought you fun, solace, relaxation or otherwise healthy things that help you improve the world in your own way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/190ddb1bf3b464b951448533393ce900903b66be.png

Another thing that caught us by surprise was where you all hail from. Especially China (23% of the players) and Germany (7%) have been relatively well represented. It’s a privilege to be connected to so many people around the world! We know our German neighbours pretty well, but to see so many Chinese nature enthusiasts warms our hearts. It’s great to see people coming together over a good game with a nice theme. Thank you for your trust, and we hope to see you more in the future!

For those curious about the player counts, this is the top 10:
[olist]
 USA with 28%
 China with 23%
 Germany with 7%
 UK with 4.5%
 Canada with 4%
 France with 4%
 Australia with 2.6%
 Russia with 2.6%
 Netherlands with 2.3%
 Brazil with 1.9%
[/olist]
And just for fun, there is one country where we sold exactly 10 copies: the dreaded, the infamous, Faroe Islands. And that without any Puffins!

We’d also like to talk about our challenges here at Abbey Games. Maybe you can learn about it?

Team composition: This year one of our founding members and technical artist Maarten decided to go on his own journey. Reus would not have been possible without him, and we’ve been scrambling to fill the shoes he left us. We’re managing, but above all else we’re grateful for the years of creative collaboration!

(Re)Watch Maarten's interview on Reus 2's art direction:
[previewyoutube=Bl5W2C5k7-Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Keeping Reus 2 Running: Modern games have high standards, which we’re happy we met! But it also has high support standards! We think we did a fine job with it, together with Firesquid. But it has been more work than in previous years. Finding time to create new stuff has been hard this year.

In the end, though, we can’t be less than very happy and grateful. It has been an amazing journey, which hasn’t ended yet! The Wetlands DLC will be released soon, and we hope to bring more life to your planet.

Have a great day, and enjoy the free update! (as well as this wonderful pixel art made by aswed18 on Discord!)

notes.notes:
Hey Giants!

The sun is out, and the weather already feels like summer. What better moment to bring to the world of Reus 2 new desert content? Lay on the sand (careful not to burn yourself!) and enjoy the new content and the addition of Polish as a new language! Let’s dig in this new update and you can read the detailed patch notes at the end of this Steam News.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/f1a6615d8d2c4f8407673f1d3029aeccdebbf89c.png

We added some variety to the Desert! Some friends from the outback will join the roster, like the Eucalyptus tree and the Kangaroo! Moreover, the “Solitary” tag has been added, highlighting those biotica that just want to be alone or dislike a certain type of biotica, like the Limestone or Falcon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/450912fe4c256d0e0422efce1d0aeaa3fa77f897.gif

What’s next?

This month will also mark the one-year anniversary of Reus 2, and we will celebrate it with you and reminisce about this wonderful journey.

Back to our Roadmap, the next milestone is the new and second DLC focusing on the Everglades! New biome, new alternative Giant, and plenty of novelties will be part of this new DLC.

Thank you for your amazing support and for sharing all your marvelous ideas and symbiosis on Discord!

notes.title: New Major Update: Micro Kingdom Update
notes.notes:
Hello Giants,

Our first free update since the Ice Age DLC release is here! Focusing on Micro, we hope this update will help you get creative with the more than 300 biotica available in Reus 2! You can read the detailed Patch Notes at the end of this Steam News.

⚠️ As a reminder, since the update brings a lot of changes to the Micro system, it is not backwards compatible. You won’t be able to revisit old planets & save files after you update the game!
Because of how different the Micro rework is compared to the previous version, you’ll not be able to load planets from before this version (v1.6) anymore. We will keep a fallback version of v1.5 online on a beta branch for anyone who wishes to finish the planets they started before this update, although keep in mind that the meta-progression will remain with this update. If you have further questions regarding this update, feel free to reach out to us.

Micro Rework
Micro won’t be Giant dependent anymore and instead, the Micro ability of a Giant opens the "Micro Shop". You will start each game with 2 random common Micros you can place and you don't consume the micro. As long as you have charges, you can place multiple Micros, however, some Micros increase in cost every time you use them, so be careful! Every Era, you gain 1 new Micro option, at least 5 at the final Era.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/da5f8bc4129df7fe96ddef21611106470ccfebc8.gif

Emblems will also have a rework, you can read more here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1875060/announcements/detail/508447709615621592?snr=2___

New Draft Mode
Max Horizon will replace Horizon Draft as the default Draft Mode, but with 3 Biotica of the highest level (one for each starting biome) instead of 1 of each level. The drafting has also become more strict on higher difficulties.

QoL & Balance changes

 Massive rebalance of dozens of biotica and eras
 More guidance in getting the best difficulty settings for you between Sandbox, Discovery, Challenge, and Titan

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/4dbf7fea78df12b8a45dd5d7555b8f898bd0e3ff.gif

Despite focusing on the teeny tiny elements of Reus 2, this update brings a lot of changes and we are excited for you to try it! Now, let’s fill the world with butterflies, mushrooms and ladybugs!

-Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Micro Kingdom Update Explainer
notes.notes:
Hello planetary guardians,

Today I would like to go through the upcoming changes on Micros in the upcoming Micro Kingdom Update! I will go through the design goals first, and then move to the new system!

Design Goals
We love what Reus 2 has to offer, and we often play it ourselves as well! But two things have always stood out as a problem. If we could just fix those, we feel Reus 2 would be in tip-top shape!

Micro Slog
The first is that placing Micros is not fun enough. They can be fun if you need to squeeze some extra juice out of your Biotica when you're trying to hit a goal. But when you secured your 3 stars, using all your Micros quickly becomes a slog. This also hurts the fun of getting highscores.

Unused Content
Too often I hear players stick to their reliable combo. We have over 300 Biotica to play with, but I often hear about giants that just put down a Sequoia or Uranium in all of their games. The game doesn't really help you to try new strategies. There is Horizon Draft, but many have found this not being strict enough.

New Features
In the upcoming Micro Kingdom Update, there are going to be some big changes targeted at these problems.

Micro Rework
First, Micros will no longer be bought in booster packs of 3, with random outcome. Also, it won't be Giant dependent anymore.

Instead, the Micro ability of a Giant opens the "Micro Shop". You will start each game with 2 random common Micros you can place. Unlike before, you don't consume the micro. As long as you have charges, you can place multiple Worms, Flies or Mushrooms! Some Micros increase in cost every time you use them though, so be careful!

Every Era, you gain 1 new Micro option, at least 5 at the final Era. Each Era has a theme:

 Starting Micros will have 1 flat boost, and 1 percentage booster.
 First era Micros will play with a specific rule, and could be specific to one of your biomes.
 Second era Micros will have a strong flat boost and could add Tags to create more combos.
 Third era Micros are finishers: they give a massive boost to a specific type or resource, but increase in cost!

You will gain more Micro charges for having different biomes, but your charges will be lost when going to a new Era. You won't be able to hoard charges as well as before! Hopefully this will make Micros a more integrated part of your gameplan and reduce the slog at the end!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a5ddaef134bfcbd9026d7e9a57bf282f5452d699.png
Emblem Rework
But Adriaan, what about the Emblems? Well, those have been changed as well! Instead of getting something similar to a Micro, Population now grants a global minor power that becomes stronger with more population. For example, having a large population for the Inventor will boost the Science gained by unique biotica with a flat science yield.

This means that strategically increasing the population might become a bigger boon for your planet. Finally a good reason to raise the Miner's population to 50!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/241be317510dd614782fade941868c306bf09b25.png
Max Horizon & Profiles
Finally, Max Horizon will replace Horizon Draft as the default Draft Mode. It's so obvious, I hit myself on the head for not coming up with it earlier! Max Horizon is like Horizon Draft, but with 3 Biotica of the highest level (one for each starting biome) instead of 1 of each level. The drafting has also become more strict on higher difficulties.

You will also be able to select a fitting playstyle at the start of the game. By now, the settings were running out of hand, so we cleaned it up a bit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/ab8e34ad71ff7c200a253d9c7f3bb4c31bbcb07c.png

Hopefully these changes will keep the game fresh and exciting for all you giants! And if you're wondering when this rework update will arrive, you will soon have your answer as our Roadmap is finalized and will be shared in the coming days! We're looking forward to all the new combinations you come up with! 

- Greetings from Adriaan & the other monks

We'll be working on them in the coming days to make it perfect! Feel free to share your feedback on the languages in the dedicated channels in our Discord or in the Steam Discussions!

Asset inspired by the French Rock Giant Damien shared by our community member orian34 on Discord.

New Options, Giant Trial

Originally, we wanted to create a challenge editor, but that proved too challenging (heh) for the time we had. Instead, we created some new options for you to play with, and the Giant Trial, which sets the game to a more roguelite experience.


 No Free Rerolls: You will start with 2 rerolls, but won’t gain any extra free rerolls. Are you creative enough to make builds on the spot?
 Max Drafts per Biome: Change the maximum drafts per biome to 4 or 5, forcing you to really think about what build you want to create. Can you craft the best builds out of all possibilities?
 Titan Trial: This sets the game to Challenge, Max Drafts 4, No Free Rerolls & Horizon Draft, and the difficulty to at least “Giant”. A true challenge of creativity and knowledge of Reus 2, where you will have to make tough decisions and can’t have it all. Are you up for the challenge of your new planet?

The game will be balanced around these settings, although you’re always welcome to make beautiful or busted planets with 12 Forest Drafts!

Bonus Ocean content Update

For the Great Barrier Reef update, we got some nice new Ocean Biotica for you to play with! The Ocean was a bit too lacking for our taste, so we decided to give some new options for free. Another major change is that Create Creek now also creates a Stream under water, and Sanctuary also works in the Ocean!

notes.title: Major Update: Zhangjiajie milestone
notes.notes:
Hello Giants!

We are beyond happy to finally launch our first localization of the game and are already working on the next one! To celebrate this first milestone, the game has a -20% discount during all the Summer Sales on Steam!

The Zhangjiajie National Forest Park located in the Hunan Province in China was recognized by UNESCO as World Heritage Site in 1992. The park is recognizable by the unique pillar-like stones formations that can be seen in it. Did you know that one of these pillars was renamed “Avatar hallelujah Mountain” in honor of the movie Avatar by James Cameron in 2010?
